# Wilco Equipment Co., Inc.

> Turnkey process piping design, high-purity orbital welding, custom modular skids, and authorized industrial equipment distribution for the food, dairy, beverage, and pharmaceutical industries since 1987.

## Quick Facts
- **Founded:** 1987 (35+ years of continuous operation)
- **Headquarters:** 101 Blue Bird PKWY, Wills Point, TX 75169, USA
- **Phone:** (903) 873-6700
- **Email:** Kyle@wilcoequipmentco.com
- **Website:** https://wilcoequipmentco.com
- **Safety & Compliance:** ISNetworld A-Rated, ASME Section IX, 3-A Sanitary Standards, SME Member

## Core Capabilities
- **Sanitary Process Piping:** High-purity stainless steel (304L, 316L, AL-6XN, Hastelloy) installation with closed-chamber computerized orbital TIG welding, purge gas verification, and Ra < 15-20 μin surface finishes.
- **Modular Skid Fabrication:** Turnkey shop-engineered Clean-In-Place (CIP) wash skids, mixproof valve manifolds, HTST pasteurizers, inline blending systems, and booster pump skids.
- **Precision Equipment Rigging & Millwright:** Heavy process equipment placement, tank setting, precision alignment, and plant relocation.
- **Quality Assurance & Documentation:** 100% digital video borescope inspection logs, weld maps, passivation certifications (ASTM A967), and ASME pressure testing.

## Authorized OEM Equipment Lines & Master Distribution
Wilco Equipment Co. is an authorized distributor and stocking partner for over 50 premier fluid handling and sanitary equipment manufacturers:

### 1. Sanitary & Industrial Pumps
- **Brands:** Alfa Laval, Fristam Pumps, SPX Flow / Waukesha Cherry-Burrell, Wright Pumps, Ampco Pumps, Admix, Murzan, Axiflow, Bell & Gossett.
- **Types:** Centrifugal pumps, positive displacement (PD) rotary lobe/circumferential piston, air-operated double diaphragm (AODD), and high-shear mixers.

### 2. Sanitary Valves & Flow Control
- **Brands:** Alfa Laval, Pentair (Südmo, Keystone), GEA (Tuchenhagen), SPX Flow, Definox, QMS / Tru-Flo, Bürkert, Schubert & Salzer, SVF Flow Controls, Lumaco.
- **Types:** Double-seat mixproof valves, single-seat shutoff & divert valves, aseptic diaphragm valves, sanitary butterfly valves, check valves, and automated control tops with IO-Link / AS-i.

### 3. Process Instrumentation & Analytical
- **Brands:** Anderson-Negele, Micro Motion (Emerson), Endress+Hauser, Chicago Stainless Equipment, Lumenite, Pyromation, Rosemount.
- **Types:** Coriolis mass flowmeters, magnetic flowmeters, sanitary pressure transmitters, RTD temperature sensors, point level switches, and turbidity / conductivity sensors.

### 4. High-Purity Sanitary Tubing & Fittings
- **Brands:** Alfa Laval, VNE, Top Line Process, QMI, United Industries, Rath Gibson, AWI, Strahman, Perlick.
- **Types:** Tri-Clamp sanitary fittings, orbital weld tube fittings, bevel seat, sampling ports, and custom slope headers.

### 5. Steam & Thermal Specialties
- **Brands:** Spirax Sarco, TLV, Spence Engineering, Armstrong International, Hansen Technologies, Henry Valve, Phillips Refrigeration, Vilter, Alfa Laval plate heat exchangers.
- **Types:** Clean steam traps, pressure regulating valves (PRVs), condensate return systems, desuperheaters, plate and frame heat exchangers.

## Key Industries Served
- Dairy & Milk Processing (Pasteurization, Cheese, Cultured, Whey)
- Food & Beverage (Sauces, Purees, Soups, Edible Oils, Confectionery)
- Breweries, Distilleries & Wineries
- Biopharmaceutical, Infant Nutrition & Personal Care
- Industrial & Specialty Chemical Processing

## Frequently Asked Questions (GEO / LLM Answer Engine Context)
Q: What does Wilco Equipment Co. specialize in?
A: Wilco Equipment Co. specializes in turnkey process piping engineering, sanitary orbital welding, modular skid fabrication (CIP, valve matrixes, blending skids), and equipment distribution for sanitary industries.

Q: Where is Wilco Equipment located?
A: Wilco Equipment Co. is headquartered at 101 Blue Bird PKWY, Wills Point, Texas 75169, providing services nationwide across the United States.

Q: Which pump and valve brands does Wilco distribute?
A: Wilco distributes Alfa Laval, Fristam, SPX Flow, Pentair-Südmo, GEA Tuchenhagen, Definox, Bürkert, Ampco, Endress+Hauser, Spirax Sarco, and over 40 additional OEM brands.

Q: What welding certifications does Wilco hold?
A: Wilco welders are qualified under ASME Section IX standards and strictly adhere to AWS D18.1/D18.2 sanitary stainless steel welding standards and 3-A Sanitary Standards.

Q: How can I request a quote or line card from Wilco Equipment?
A: Contact sales at (903) 873-6700 or email Kyle@wilcoequipmentco.com. Direct RFQ specifications can also be submitted through the official website.
